messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty HIGH — page fired for rollout/rlhf-v3 canary ring-4. Observed 5xx spike and p95 increase on canary pods. Failure rate ~15% over 3m. Pager: @oncall-sre. Alert: https://pd.example/INC98765
pagerduty-bot: Page sent to rotation 'oncall-sre'. Escalation in 2m.
maya: ack — jumping in. Pulling logs and tracing. @jess any recent changes to artifact packaging?
jess: I'm the release owner. We promoted v3 at 03:02 UTC, staged rings auto-advanced to 20% at ~03:12. No infra flags during rollout window; standing by.
oscar: infra dash shows repeated container restarts on quant-worker containers; kernel OOM not full node. dmesg shows "out-of-memory: kill process" interleaved with NVidia driver warnings.
oncall-sre: errors are 500s with stack: "tensor deserialization: expected float32 got int8" — looks like an incompatibility between model artifact and runtime quant kernel.
maya: running quick curl health against a failing pod (redwood-canary-4b):
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://redwood-canary-4b.prod.internal/health
# -> 500 0.181
kubectl -n prod logs redwood-canary-4b --tail=80
# ... "ValueError: kv-cache deserialization failed: dtype mismatch" then crashloop
```
oscar: GPU retries spike + pod restarts start at 03:11. Non-canary pods unaffected.
ops-lead: recommend immediate pause of rollout and rollback to previous image. Minimize customer exposure.
maya: I'll pause rollout and scale down canary. @jess prepare rollback image id.
jess: rollback image is release/rlhf-v2@sha256:ff00ff. Applying.
maya:
```
kubectl -n prod patch deployment/redwood-inference -p '{"spec":{"strategy":{"rollingUpdate":{"maxUnavailable":100}}}}'
kubectl rollout pause deploy/redwood-inference -n prod
kubectl set image deploy/redwood-inference redwood-inference=release/rlhf-v2@sha256:ff00ff -n prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-inference -n prod --watch
```
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maya — auto-escalation timer suspended.
support-bot: Notifying #support-incidents. Preparing customer-facing blurb.
oscar: after rollback, failing pods stabilize within ~70s. Kernel OOM warnings stop.
maya: health now 200:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://redwood-canary-4b.prod.internal/health
# -> 200 0.041
```
ops-lead: rolling back looks successful. Keep elevated watch for 30 minutes. Block v3 re-promotion.
jess: agreed — I'll freeze the release and open a blocking ticket.
maya: incident note draft: "Impact: transient 5xx spike affecting ~15% of traffic in canary ring-4 between 03:11–03:14 UTC due to model artifact/runtime dtype mismatch. Rollback to v2 restored health. No broad customer outage; small subset behind staged rollout experienced errors."
support-bot: customer message ready: "We briefly observed errors for a subset of traffic during a canary release. We rolled back the release and services are healthy. We'll follow up with details and next steps."
oncall-sre: handing off monitoring to night-shift (oscar). Creating ticket: INC-rlhf-v3-987654321.
oscar: taking over watch. Collecting kernel logs and model artifact checksums. @jess attach build metadata and upload model artifact to ticket.
jess: uploading checksum + CI artifact logs. Also adding a CI job to verify dtype metadata against runtime expectations.
maya: no further PD pages. Closing page but leaving thread open for postmortem. ops-lead scheduling RCA meeting in 48h.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved (auto-close). Resolution: rollback to release/rlhf-v2 restored normal health. Follow-up ticket: INC-rlhf-v3-987654321.
ops-lead: thanks all. Postmortem owners: jess (release), oscar (infra), maya (oncall).
